epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of unindexed binary files due to parsing errors from X to 0
requirements: R1: Support text extraction from binary files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) for full-text search indexing.

slices.title: Fix binary file text extraction
slices.jtbd: When implementing binary text extraction for this epic, I want to use an appropriate parser to extract raw text from uploaded files, so that the document content can be correctly indexed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a binary file upload
When the backend processes it
Then it uses an appropriate parser (e.g., Apache Tika) to extract text, rather than simply casting raw bytes to a UTF-8 string.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Binary parsing step in indexing pipeline
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful text extraction rate from binary files to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease search UI render failures due to missing pagination metadata from X to 0
requirements: R1: Return total elements and total pages metadata alongside items array in paginated search responses.

slices.title: Add pagination metadata to search response
slices.jtbd: When implementing pagination metadata for this epic, I want to include total counts in the response payload, so that the client UI can correctly render pagination controls.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a paginated search request
When the backend returns results
Then the response payload includes total elements and total pages alongside the items array.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase proportion of paginated search endpoints returning total count metadata to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the availability of exported analytics reports from 0 to 100%
requirements: R1: Generate and return CSV/PDF reports of knowledge base utilization statistics or trigger an EIOS sync.

slices.title: Implement analytics export endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the analytics export for this epic, I want to generate statistics reports or trigger an EIOS sync, so that the exported utilization statistics can be used in external systems.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an admin user
When they request an analytics export
Then the system generates and returns a CSV/PDF report containing search queries, views, and downloads, or triggers an EIOS sync.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase analytics export success rate to 100%
